items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: If he isn't there, I'm really lost. Because I'm so used to him getting in that part.

ctx.x: Well, yeah. Is that Percy's idea?
I don't know how Poesies got that lined up now, but I noticed that myself. He put the drums in between Paul and then. Yeah. I noticed that myself.
In the old days, I understand the drums were always in back.
